== Title ==
<span lang="ja">イヴァックス参謀将校</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。デス・スターの位置カード上にいるなら、帝国軍の宇宙船は"リアクション"としてデス・スターの星系カードに移動できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">帝国軍情報部に属するリーダーで、反乱軍艦隊の進路を予想する正確な追跡情報を握っている。彼は巧みな宇宙船配備及び移動計画で、多くの基地の弱点を補ってきた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Officer Evax]].

'''Lore''' — This Imperial Intelligence leader holds accurate tracking data that predicts Rebel fleet courses. With skillful starship deployment and movement plans, he has covered the weaknesses of many bases.

'''Game text''' — Add 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If he is at a Death Star location card, Imperial starships may move to the Death Star system card as a “react.”

== Comparison with the English printing ==
位置カード vs site, 星系カード vs system, and "リアクション" vs 'react'. Lore says he holds tracking data and has covered base weaknesses, not that he saved vulnerable bases.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-officerevax-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Officer Evax]].</ref>
